analysis.weighting: average three policy draws within each stochastic policy/scenario; then equal scenario weight; equal seed counts per family
analysis.paired_units: scenario family and seed, not individual policy draws
analysis.bootstrap: percentile 95% paired bootstrap, resample seeds within each family, retain the observed number of cases per family
analysis.percentage_definition: 100 * (mean baseline - mean candidate) / mean baseline; positive favors candidate
analysis.interval_scope: Monte Carlo scenario variation conditional on these synthetic families, not uncertainty over real services or alternative models; unadjusted exploratory comparisons
analysis.zero_denominator: relative reduction and its interval are null when the relevant mean baseline is zero; absolute differences remain defined
analysis.combined_scope: descriptive mixture of legacy and generated synthetic families with 60/96-minute horizons; inspect source slices and every family
